name: Pterodactyl-Panel
description: Pterodactyl® is a free, open-source game server management panel built with PHP, React, and Go. Designed with security in mind, Pterodactyl runs all game servers in isolated Docker containers while exposing a beautiful and intuitive UI to end users. Stop settling for less. Make game servers a first class citizen on your platform. All the setups requiried is on the support area (Discord or Forum) WARNINGS !!! The Latest Version requir a Redis Install on your Server !!! WARNINGS
